title: Many color-profile associations cause excessive CPU during HEIF open
ai_system: Anthropic OSS Scanner (model not specified for this finding)
summary: Opening a file regenerated and compared a color-profile property for every color-profile association, causing excessive CPU use.
ai_role: The item-level libheif advisory explicitly attributes discovery to Anthropic's OSS Scanner as ANT-2026-H7YE4FE8. The release notes independently state that all listed security issues were found by the scanner. The Anthropic program sources establish model-based scanning, but no per-case model is identified.
classification_note: The primary advisory establishes a publicly disclosed security finding and direct Anthropic OSS Scanner attribution. No CVE had been assigned in the libheif release notes at the checked time; the distinct GHSA is used. No exploitation or zero-day status is asserted.
remediation_note: Reading and encoding now store color profiles separately so opening the file does not create new properties. Fixed in libheif 1.23.7. The libheif v1.23.7 security release is dated 2026-10-26; deployed patch status is not checked.

impacts.conditions: A crafted HEIF with many color-profile associations can make libheif file-open spend seconds/minutes of CPU before image selection; source observed CPU exhaustion and no memory corruption.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not establish exploitation in the wild.
